svg.text: Hypothesis: one real input with six visual cells keeps paste, autofill and screen readers working; every outcome is a named status line.
Anchors: Mundial desktop (ruled 1px boxes), Paperless Post (invite as a physical object), Premier League (tabular numerals) from references/rsvp-save-the-date-sports-ticket-2026-10-14.md.

Commitments: auto-check on the 6th digit, button stays as the fallback; resend is a dashed disabled control with a live countdown; no shake, no toast; the 10 status lines (right) are the OTP contract.
